brief.summary: Stocks fell as front-end and long-end yields rose, with the curve steepening after the hot PMI. Oil surged on stalled Iran talks and strike risk, gold fell, and credit spreads widened; the dollar was not discussed. The Fed was described as hawkish, with at least one more hike expected by year-end and speakers saying more needs to be done. The dominant narrative is an energy-driven inflation shock colliding with higher rates, squeezing consumers and credit even as AI and earnings optimism persist. The show's overall tone was risk-off.
notable_quotes: The sentiment right now is for yields to go higher.
